one_line: A ranking by age with each box held up to the lens and one word of every subtitle in colour.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman at a table behind an open cardboard box, speaking to the lens and gesturing. Yellow subtitle "טושים" at 0:00, then "שלי.", "לדעתי לכל", "ועל מה אני הכי". Transcript garbled. No pack held yet.
q1_hook.why: A face and a voice from frame zero (H4, F6), with the subject word on screen at 0:00 (T3, H6). The ranking-by-age promise names a buyer's real question (K6). But the opening words are split into fragments, no pack is held until 0:07 (S1), and the promise takes 6 s to state (H1, H2).

beats.what: Talking behind the box, gesturing; "טושים שלי. לדעתי לכל גיל ועל מה אני הכי"
First place: a Turbo Maxi 12-pack held up; "טובים להתחלה", "שורדים"; a thinner kind, ages 4 to 5
beats.why: The first pick comes with its age.

beats.what: Second place: several Turbo Glitter packs held; "מופתעת מכמה שזה תופס", "בגיל שלוש ארבע חמש"
beats.why: A surprise and a target child.

beats.what: Third place: Giant Pastel and Maxi Fluo; a lilac marker at her lips at 0:45; "עם הבסיסי", "מכיר"
beats.why: Start basic, upgrade later; the longest stretch.

beats.what: She looks aside, then holds a blue Decor Materials box; "וואו תקשיבו זה", "שבע ומעלה"
beats.why: A change of tone and a new age band.

beats.what: Holds a Playmobil-style table painted with the markers; "תראו למה היא הפכה", "לא חייבת להיות על דפים."
beats.why: The one proof object, at the end.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption only says where to buy: craft shops and Max Stock.
q2_flow.why: A ranked list with a new box held up per place is a clear spine (R3, K2), and "וואו תקשיבו" at 1:06 restarts attention (E2). But long talking stretches over one framing, 0:40 to 1:06 above all, and 88 s with no prompt to save or send sag (R1, R2). Parents could send it, but nothing asks (R5, R7).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no spoken or written ask, it ends on "לא חייבת להיות על דפים." Caption: "שורת המומלצים שלייי" and where to buy, "במיטב חנויות היצירה וגם ברשת מקס סטוק".
q3_cta.why: No ask in 88 s: no keyword (C3), no question (C5), no send to a named parent (C4), no save prompt for a list built to be saved (R7). The buying route sits only in the caption, not said or shown at the end (C6).

q4_shown.what: Giotto packs held to the lens, readable by name: Turbo Maxi, Turbo Glitter, Turbo Giant Pastel, Turbo Maxi Fluo, Decor Materials. A painted Playmobil-style table from 1:18. She never draws with them on camera. No price, child or paper.
q4_shown.why: Every pack is shown with its name and age from 0:07 (S1, K5), and her ranking is a first-person verdict (S6). But the markers are never used on camera and the painted table is the only proof (S2). With 5 products and no hero, it reads as a catalogue (H3, C7).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 88 s, 8.8 s average: mostly one static framing with jump cuts at 8.4, 19.3, 25.2, 40.5, 66.1, 71.2 and 81.9 s. Word-by-word subtitles change every 1 to 2 s in yellow, red or white. Ends abruptly on the last subtitle.
q5_edit.why: Jump cuts and word-by-word subtitles give a quick feel within one scene (E2, E4), and the colour changes make the speech easy to follow muted (T1). But 88 s on one framing, with products doing the only motion (R3, R1, R2), and it stops without a wrap-up (E8).

q6_topic.what: Giotto markers ranked by age from 2 to 7+, with her pick and reasoning for each. Serves a parent choosing markers for a child.
q6_topic.why: "What fits my child's age" is a real buying question that a ranked list answers (K6, K4). A shopper may save or forward it (R7, R5). No occasion is named (K7), and a product ranking carries no peak feeling beyond her surprise (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A static medium shot at eye level in a bright room against a white wall, a cardboard box and a table in front of her. Phone propped, no cuts of angle. She holds the packs at chest height toward the lens.
q7_filmed.why: Direct eye contact, a plain background and held-up packs look native and keep the product readable (F6, H8, F4). The light is even and the frame sharp (F7, F1, F3). Packs held at chest height sit behind the subtitles, which cross them at about 65% down (F2, T2).

q8_text.on_screen: Large bold word-by-word subtitles, one to four words, centred at about 65% down, one word or line in yellow, red or white: "טושים" (0:00), "במקום הראשון" (0:06), "טובים" (0:10), "שורדים" (0:15), "מופתעת" (0:27), "נוצצים אוהבות" (0:37), "מתחילה" (0:52), "לגיל" (1:07), "פליימוביל" (1:16), "הגמישות" (1:22). No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "שורת המומלצים שלייי". About 15 words: a one-line title, where to buy (craft shops and Max Stock). No hashtags, no ask, no partnership word.
q8_text.why: A big coloured key word every 1 to 2 s is easy to read and reads muted (T1, T5), but it is a near-verbatim transcript sitting at the edge of the bottom 35% and over the packs (T2, T4, F2). The caption has no keywords or hashtags and no disclosure (T7, S7, T8).

weak_points: 88 s on one framing; no ask, save prompt or price; subtitles cover the products; her profession never stated; one proof object at the end; a caption with no keywords or partnership word.
lumebook_takeaway: Talk to the lens with books held up by age (2, 3 to 4, 5+), one place per 15 s, a hook line first, a save prompt last.
not_verified: Her profession (the handle ends _slp; nothing on screen); whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, no word); the spoken words of the first 6 s (garbled transcript, subtitles used); music (none evident). Corrections to the first pass: first Giotto pack is held at 0:07; the marker at her lips at 0:45 is a lilac one; the last subtitle is "לא חייבת להיות על דפים." at 1:27, the object is a toy table the subtitles call "פליימוביל".
